blurb_html: Fill and shape a rice triangle through plastic wrap, without handling the rice directly.
description: Fill and shape a rice triangle through plastic wrap, without handling the rice directly.
equipment_html: Large bowl or sushi tub to cool the rice
Small bowl of water for your hands

items.amount_html: 1–2 tsp per onigiri
1 sheet, cut in thirds

intro_html: One shaping method, from rice to serving. Prepare one of the shop-inspired fillings before you start. For eggplant or pepperoncino, mix the filling through the rice first and skip the central well. Back to hand shaping and all fillings →

notes.html:
• Onigiri are plain steamed rice with salt; sushi rice is seasoned with vinegar, sugar and salt.
  • Use Japanese short-grain rice — jasmine or long-grain falls apart.

steps.body_html:
• Wash the rice, then soak it 20–30 minutes in the water.
  • Rice cooker: use the short-grain cycle. Pot: bring to a boil over medium heat with the lid slightly ajar, then cover tightly and cook on low for 12–13 minutes, until the water is absorbed. Rest off the heat, covered, for 10 minutes, then fluff.
  • This batch makes about 330 g cooked rice, enough for three onigiri.
  • Keep it plain: no vinegar or sugar. Cool only until comfortable to hold, keeping it covered with a damp towel.
steps.title: Cook the rice

steps.body_html:
• For eggplant or pepperoncino, use rice with the prepared filling already mixed through it. Shape directly from that rice and skip the separate filling and central well below.
  • Line a small bowl with plastic wrap, leaving enough overhang to gather it closed. Sprinkle a little salt inside.
  • Add about 50 g warm rice, make a well, and put 1–2 tsp prepared filling in the center.
  • Cover with another 50 g rice, seal it around the filling, and add a little salt on top.
steps.title: Fill the wrap

steps.body_html:
• Gather the wrap above the rice and twist it closed. Shape gently through the wrap; do not squeeze the rice hard.
  • Cup the rice from underneath with your left hand. Bend your right hand into a roof to make one corner, turn the rice a third of a turn, and repeat for three corners.
  • Flatten each face lightly. Unwrap for serving; remove all plastic before eating.

how.caption: Rice and filling on plastic wrap in a bowl; gather and twist it shut, then press the triangle.

steps.title: Gather and shape

steps.body_html:
• Wrap a third of a nori sheet round the bottom of each onigiri just before eating for crisp nori.
  • Or coat the faces in furikake with damp fingers. Serve freshly made.
